children: Oricell Therapeutics Holdings Limited, a cancer immunotherapy company formerly known as Yuanqi Biotech, said on September 1 that it has appointed Guo Feng as chief executive officer, responsible for the group's overall business and operations, according to Jiemian News. Founder, chairman and former CEO Yang Huanfeng will remain chairman and president. Before joining Oricell Therapeutics, Guo served as CEO of Hong Kong-listed biopharmaceutical company Yiteng Jiahe.

title: Oricell Therapeutics Appoints Guo Feng as CEO
